'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a female [[NPC]] student located by [[Fangspire Chasm]] Station, [[Resonance Nexus|{{tt|Solis Lens Array|Resonance Nexus}}]], seen speaking to '''Lyralyn'''. 

==Location==

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Anastyn:''' The landscape and architecture where I'm from are stunning. Dazzling even, like the sun.
:'''Lyralyn:'''  Why are you boasting about [[Septimont]] all of a sudden? I mean, it is incredible, but still.
:'''Anastyn:''' But look at that greatsword plunged straight into the earth! It's just so raw, so visceral… it gives me chills!
:'''Anastyn:''' It reminds me of Ephor [[Augusta]]'s sword cleaving through the mountains at the hunting grounds.<ref>{{Quest|By Sun's Burning Hand}}</ref> It literally carved out a new future for [[Rinascita]].
:'''Anastyn:''' I'll bet it was the same with the [[Exostrider]]'s sword here. It must've laid the foundation for [[Lahai-Roi]]'s future.
:'''Lyralyn:''' Okay, now you're giving me chills. Still, I'm more curious to know how much energy was required to create this wonder.
:'''Anastyn:''' Well, uncovering mysteries ike that is the whole reason we enrolled, right? I can't wait!
----
;After {{Quest|Starlights from Yesterdays}}
:;'''[[Anastyn]]''' I heard the Exostrider actually swung that humongous thing and fought the Threnodian! Is that true?!
:;'''Lyralyn''' Of course it is! The Void Storms and all those Threnodian creations are gone now, aren't they?
:;'''Anastyn''' Ah! To be born in Septimont and miss a duel of such grandeur...
:'''Anastyn:''' Look! The greatsword is actually gone! I heard the Exostrider actually swung that humongous thing and fought the Threnodian! Is that true?!
:'''Lyralyn:''' Of course it is! The Void Storms and all those Threnodian creations are gone now, aren't they?
:'''Anastyn:''' Ah! How can this be!
:'''Anastyn:''' This is bound to be the single greatest regret of my life. I hate being from Septimont!
:'''Lyralyn:''' Eh? Why?
:'''Anastyn:''' Because I missed it! Oh, what I'd give to fight in a battle of that scale myself! Even if I died... it would've been worth the journey.
:'''Lyralyn:''' ...You Septimontians. I'll never understand how your brains work.
{{Dialogue End}}
